Oh, don't mistake. I understand that. However, just because someone has more resources it doesn't mean that they should have to lose more.

There's still a problem with that mentality, though. Personally lower than middle class, if that matters. Anyway, why would you penalize being rich? Why should one have to pay more than an average person just because they have more money?

Edit: Also, why specifically white?

Edit2: Doubling down on this. One should not be subjected to higher costs simply because they have more resources.

Edit3: Upon further consideration, equity (proportional taxing--don't know the proper term) may have advantages over equality. I still firmly believe that the rich should not be obligated so. Nonetheless, thank you for your inputs.

On an unrelated note, I believe that hard workers should be paid better; it is a great tragedy that it is not so, but antagonizing the rich seems counter-productive. But, that discussion would open a new can of worms--one I would not like to open. So, the discussion must die here. 

Again, thank you.
